exposure: Surgical Marker Navigation (SMN) system Sirius Pintuition(r)
outcome: excision of non-palpable axillary lymph nodes
cohort: A total of 84 patients undergoing breast-conserving surgery and lymph node excision guided by the SMN system between December 2022 and May 2023.
finding: The use of Sirius Pintuition(r) SMN for non-palpable breast tumors and non-palpable lymph nodes is feasible, achieving an 88.1% marker retrieval rate.
